readiness_reason: 本户接触面及责任边界已局部具体化；连续公共tie-in与雨水性能/受纳证据仍缺，不足以Architecture Design Freeze。此为接口完整度说明，不是回归裁决。
why: 在西来货物转为轻载之前就近小修理与值守，家庭小院退到户内低肩，避免与公共横通争地

design_context.regional_family: 山地西来接驳前沿；东域山地适应与中域转运行为交接，不把方位名 west 等同西域
design_context.technology: 成熟前现代石木、台地、挡护、步级；魔法不能替代工程或供给
design_context.users: 两户家庭、修理工、值守复核者、少量随货到达者；具体户籍与任命未证
design_context.maturity: EARLY_GROWTH 的条件性演化提案；非已发生历史
design_context.existing_note: 地表和近地切片已读；未认定历史为空白，深部存在人工/生成结构位置证据。

planning_causal_context.rights: 拟议家庭用地；公院/通行地役仍属共同协调，两户没有圈占权
planning_causal_context.flow: 西首卸→手提入低肩收件→小修理→交还公院/向东轻载
planning_causal_context.rhythm: 批次来货/日常家庭；洁净接收与污物带出错时
planning_causal_context.stock: 户内少量工具、日需、在手一批物品；不重复计算公共储备
planning_causal_context.externalities: 作业、等待、滴水不得挤占路带或家庭生活；热烟控制不凭空升级大型产业
planning_causal_context.growth_stage: R2-G2；R2-G3有限短宿为假设，不是实存历史
planning_causal_context.neighbor_relation: 两户以公共LANE-04联系，各自小院独立；不发明跨户后巷或共墙

private_open_yard.role: 低肩家庭日常露天使用，与修理件及来客分开
private_open_yard.adjustment: 允许等面积移位到同户可直达、未侵入通路的连通区域，至少保留2格短边；不改变公共接口

private_frontage_apron.role: 短时收件/交件和门内停步；工件不存放到公共路带

boundary_semantic.adjustment_strip: 只允许在本户 cells 内调整；超出需最小接口修订，不自动取得公地

required_adjacency: 户内家庭小院独立可达
shared_space_service_relations: 共同院与路带只引用不计入户用建筑容量；外部服务按直接服务文件预留并HOLD

required: 完整一户的睡眠、炊食、储藏、日常生活与卫生安排
小修理、工具及一批待交件暂存
可独立于来客停留使用的家庭小院
excluded: 冶炼/连续高温重锻造厂
program_requirements.magnitude: 家庭规模作业；一批在制/交接，拒绝用无限积压证明扩地
adjacency: 家庭日常不以穿过工作危险面为唯一通路
program_requirements.builder_to_prove: Plan/Section 中证明净可用空间、入口、层间通路和储物后仍完整；不以194列搜索总量当容积证明

architecture_kit_requirements: 共同文明石木构造语言、功能明确的公共—家庭阈限

支持浅窄地块混用、错时服务和可选择的垂直组织

planner_fixed: 一完整家庭/户；两户总量不增

所有服务越界必须由公共责任方闭合

local steps, retaining, rainwater collection after interface closure

conditional_local_strategy.responsibility_after_verified_selection: FULL_SCOPE_OWNER limited to parcel-local collection/retention; public receiving obligation remains NONE
quantitative_minimum: 明确有来源的设计降雨事件、历时及连续事件/恢复时间假设；不得由地表岩石臆测渗透。
明确全部屋面/汇水面和外来流入边界，核算有效入流、有效储量、初始占用及余量。
明确在设计事件与超设计事件/堵塞/满储失效时水的去向，证明不危害公共通行、邻户、基础及生活空间；不能把越界溢流称为闭合。
明确可持续清空/再利用能力、责任与中断条件；不得借尚未证实的清运服务闭合质量平衡。
conditional_local_strategy.planner_boundary: Planner 固定是否跨界、责任与所需性能证据；不指定 gutter/pipe/cistern/foundation 的尺寸、构件和布局。

known_uncertainty.evidence: 151 parcel columns and near-ground snapshot available. No proposed block is below observed ground_y, but top natural blocks are replaced for some floors.
known_uncertainty.bounded_adaptation: No cellar or deep trench; separate shallow stepped plinths rather than whole-frontage platform.
known_uncertainty.minimum_closure: Review exact load/influence volume, ground contact and known artificial-content protections before foundation freeze. Do not treat shallow no-air evidence as deep clearance.

known_uncertainty.evidence: Two beds, cooking/living, daily storage, screened 2x2 sanitation, 18-cell yard and separate family route have dimensioned model geometry.
known_uncertainty.minimum_closure: Confirm household design occupancy; finalize door privacy/weathering, ventilation, flue and fire separation, native railing/screen collision. Two-bed study is not evidence of actual household size.
Explicit target/revision/hash authorization, land-use and common-easement agreement. This task requests no construction.
Actual clean-water source/quality/capacity, food/fuel delivery cadence, reserve and interruption response. Palette does not prove materials supply.
Waste destination/responsibility, closed carrying containers, clean/dirty time separation, and one-batch handheld work limit. No throughput claim.
Compile selected native block states, roof flashing/gutters, chimney lumen and doors; recheck supports, stairs and route collision. Custom review boxes are not an executable Canonical Blueprint.
